top_level_fields.parts: object keyed by part ID (P1…PN); each entry is a part_shape
top_level_fields.domains_table: object mapping domain code -> {shell, type, description, parts}
top_level_fields.coupling_tiers: object defining 6 tier levels by cos(Δθ) range
top_level_fields.cross_coupling_index: array of detailed coupling records between specific interface components
top_level_fields.coupling_matrix: symmetric N×N matrix of {c, delta_theta, tier} for every part pair
top_level_fields.shell_hierarchy: object defining shell levels, influence formula, and key gradients
top_level_fields.phase_resonance_bands: 6 phase bands (60° each) with resident parts and inter-part c
top_level_fields.consistency_invariants: list of invariants that must hold across all entries
top_level_fields.lookup_paths: navigation guide for common query patterns

part_shape.id: string — canonical part identifier e.g. P1, P4
part_shape.label: string — human-readable title
part_shape.shell: int — dominant WPE shell (min over the part's domain shells)
part_shape.theta: float — angular coordinate of the part's master output node [0,359]
part_shape.kappa: float — curvature of the master node (κ < 0 = stable well)
part_shape.addr: string — '<shell>@<theta>' unique address; used in ptr fields
part_shape.dom: string — primary domain code for this part
part_shape.domain_codes: list[string] — all domain codes the part resolves into
part_shape.semantic_role: string — plain-language role of this part

address_format.uniqueness: every part has a unique addr; ptr fields reference parts by addr

ptr_sequence.semantics: this part FEEDS-INTO / IS-PREREQUISITE-FOR the target part

ptr_orthogonal.semantics: this part IS-ON-A-DIFFERENT-AXIS-FROM but still relates to target

ptr_opposition.semantics: this part IS-IN-ACTIVE-TENSION-WITH the target; cos(Δθ) < -0.09

MODERATE.interpretation: cos 0.34-0.61 | Δθ 52-70° | meaningful coupling with some offset

WEAK.interpretation: cos 0.09-0.34 | Δθ 70-85° | distant but present influence

ORTHOGONAL.interpretation: cos ~0 | Δθ ~90° | independent axes, no direct coupling

OPPOSITION.interpretation: cos < -0.09 | Δθ>95° | active tension or complementary opposition

shell_hierarchy.semantics: higher shells exert downward context influence on lower shells; information flows λ_high → λ_low

consistency_invariants: part.shell == min(domains_table[d].shell for d in part.domain_codes)
every addr in ptr_sequence / ptr_coupling / ptr_orthogonal / ptr_opposition must resolve to an existing part.addr
ptr_opposition is a list of strings (may be empty); entries are addrs of parts with cos(Δθ) < -0.09
ptr_orthogonal has entries with -0.09 ≤ cos(Δθ) < 0.34 (WEAK or ORTHOGONAL tier)
every cross_coupling_index entry's source_part and target_part must be in parts

lookup_paths.part_by_addr: next(p for p in doc.parts.values() if p['addr']==addr)
lookup_paths.parts_in_tier: [(pi,pj) for pi in parts for pj in parts if coupling_matrix[pi][pj]['tier']==<TIER>]
lookup_paths.shell_peers: [p for p in doc.parts.values() if p['shell']==<SHELL>]
